Multiple agencies marked the start of construction on Casa Valor, a family crisis center in Laredo for survivors of domestic violence, according to KGNS.

The center is designed to bring investigators, nurses, and other essential services together in one place, so survivors can obtain critical resources without traveling to separate offices. According to KGNS, the idea is that a survivor who leaves one office to seek a protective order, visit the district attorney, or meet an advocate at the Casa de Misericordia domestic violence shelter may not follow up on the remaining steps — and a one-stop center could make it more likely they complete all of them.

Officials expect the center to open to the public in December, according to the report.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "Construction begins on Casa Valor family crisis center in Laredo," October 30, 2026
